summary: Like clockwork and with confidence I should plan and understand that any time I need to record He will be there outside the door waxing the floor We each seek perfection as a reflection that can shine more #smallpoems #poetryport
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Like clockwork
and with confidence
I should plan
and understand
that any time I need to record
He will be there
outside the door
waxing the floor
We each seek perfection
as a reflection
that can shine more
#smallpoems
#poetryport
